status: LaunchServices transport wired into the desktop backend and selected by the production composition; the helper now needs its own TCC grants before macOS desktop capabilities become available again

implementation.backend: DeviceBackend gained macos_transport Literal['posix','launchservices'] (default posix) and macos_launcher injection; on darwin with launchservices it launches the fixed helper through the socket transport, then reuses the existing drain/collect/reclaim path
implementation.types: _Host.owned and the spawn result are now Owned = OwnedProcess | LaunchedHelper; strict typing keeps both paths
implementation.composition: composition/instance.py constructs DesktopBackend(..., macos_transport='launchservices'), so the production macOS path is the helper-owned one
implementation.half_close: the backend closes stdin after the single request frame; on a socket a full StreamWriter.close() would discard the reply, so the transport exposes a writer whose close() only shutdown(SHUT_WR)
implementation.tests: one injected-launcher test proves the backend selects the transport and writes the frame; existing posix/injected-factory tests keep their behaviour

real_probe.note: first run failed with desktop_protocol_invalid because stdin.close() tore down the socket; fixed with the half-close writer and re-verified

tcc_transition.observed: tccd AUTHREQ_ATTRIBUTION shows requesting=org.omnioperator.desktophelper with no responsible process; the permission prompts were not approved during the poll window (about 2.5 minutes), so the LaunchServices path still reports denied
tcc_transition.consequence: until the owner enables Screen & System Audio Recording, Accessibility, Input Monitoring and event posting for OmniOperator Desktop Helper in System Settings, the production macOS desktop capabilities fail closed with recovery text; the POSIX/host-attributed path still works when selected explicitly
tcc_transition.helper_binary: unchanged delivery build 9360128b (grants must be made on this final binary)

terminal_native.note: existing intermittent close(5)==False race under load; desktop changes do not touch the terminal adapter

validation.ruff: clean for backend, macos_launch and composition

limits: Functional acceptance under the LaunchServices path is blocked until the owner grants the four permissions to the helper; only probe (denied, fail-closed) was exercised end-to-end.
The composition now selects the LaunchServices transport, so production macOS desktop features are unavailable until those grants exist; this is the intended transition state, not a silent fallback.
The terminal native suite showed an intermittent close-time failure (9/10 once, 10/10 twice); it is a pre-existing PTY reclaim race and is recorded for a dedicated robustness batch.
